summary: Sanofi filed a 6-K attaching a September 14, 2026 press release announcing a strategic partnership under which Cheplapharm would take over 20 mature medicines, including Lovenox/Clexane (enoxaparin), plus three manufacturing sites in Hungary, Singapore and France. Sanofi receives a 26.4% equity stake in Cheplapharm as consideration. Commercial transfer is planned to begin Q1 2027, with site transfers subject to employee consultation and regulatory approvals, and full completion expected by Q3 2027. No board recommendation or advisor is named; Sanofi states no impact on 2026 guidance, with further financial details to come. Watch execution, antitrust clearances, employee consultation risk and valuation of the retained minority stake.
